purpose: Plain gray concrete base with fine pores, no stains or cracks

plasterTexture.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square seamless base-color texture for a real-time plaster wall material. Flat orthographic close-up of plain aged warm off-white lime plaster, representing two meters square. Very subtle fine powdery mineral grain, understated trowel mottling and tiny pores, restrained cream/gray hue variations. Uniform neutral diffuse illumination, no directional shading, no shadows, no ambient occlusion, no vignette. Edge-to-edge plaster only, no cracks, no chips, no stains, no seams, no objects, no border or text. Photorealistic material scan appearance, quiet low-contrast texture. Damage and grime will be added procedurally later.
